description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithDate' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue'. The class implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method 'getFormattedValue' that formats DateTime objects into 'Y-m-d' string format, returning null for non-DateTime inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithDate
classes.description: A formatter class that converts DateTime objects into 'Y-m-d' formatted strings.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into 'Y-m-d' string, returns null if input is not a DateTime object.
